postal_system.postal_code: nullable; no current operator-authorized public code values or syntax validated
postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU August 2026 General Addressing Issues publication places Antigua and Barbuda in its September 2025 list of countries which do not require postal codes. This establishes postcode optionality, not an exhaustive proof that no internal, office, route, P.O.-box or organization identifiers exist.
postal_system.area_rule: Only a current designated-operator-authorized identifier explicitly reconciled to a rights-cleared real postal Polygon/MultiPolygon may be drawn. An island, parish, locality, office, route, P.O. box, address, point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID planning cell or synthetic fixture is not a postal area.
postal_system.address_rule: Postal optionality, delivery instructions, locality, civic address, building and AGID cell remain separately sourced assertions.
postal_system.building_rule: Building output requires a separately permitted explicit address-building relation or common authoritative identifier.

identifier_namespaces.rule: Preserve only exact current Antigua and Barbuda Postal Service identifiers, aliases and exceptions with their documented office, route, P.O.-box, organization, point or area semantics.
Office, delivery, island, parish and locality context retains its own authority and cannot acquire postal-area authority through name or containment.
House, street, premise and building display requires explicit permitted source rows and a stable address-to-building relation.
Independent spatial index from reviewed geometry; never represented as an Antigua and Barbuda Postal Service code or official postal area.

stages.definition: Address-format inventory and synthetic Postal Forge planning pack only.
Reviewed UPU and Antigua and Barbuda authority, optionality, rights, privacy and no-proxy contract with exact reference receipts.

A current complete designated-operator-authorized denominator of all public Antigua and Barbuda postal identifiers, aliases, eligibility rules, exceptions and explicit non-area cases is fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable row identity, schema, coverage, correction policy, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The UPU no-required-postcode classification keeps postalCode nullable and is not converted into an invented code; it does not by itself satisfy M2. Every drawable identifier must be reconciled to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. If the designated operator confirms only office, route, P.O.-box, organization, point or no-code semantics, the API/app must expose that source-grounded non-area reason without manufacturing a surface, and M2 remains unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. Island, parish, locality, administration, office, route, address, building, parcel, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID planning cell and synthetic fixture proxies are prohibited. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real AG API/app, which normalizes supported input, handles loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, supports clear/re-search, and displays selected identifier, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

existing_draft_pack_boundary.rule: The existing draft Postal Forge pack remains synthetic planning evidence and is never promoted as operator data or postal geometry.

agid_integration.current_scope: AG address metadata and synthetic Postal Forge planning pack only; no real Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A licensed immutable descriptor, approved real-data artifacts and actual AG loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture an official postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, civic or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified; derived and virtual areas require separate explicit provenance and do not inherit postal authority.
